crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A small, concentrated, roughly elliptical patch of rufous-orange feathers on the lower nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A diffuse transition from a darker grey crown to a neutral grey mantle, primarily separated by the rufous nape patch.

other_distinctive_markers: The rectrices display a high-contrast pattern of large, white sub-terminal and medial spots against a dark charcoal background.
